objective: Run an independent bounded scan of the checksum-pinned Zenodo r-band archive to test the Seq 615170/615172 identity lead from the g-band diagnostic and discover any other SourceIDs within two arcseconds of the Table 2 target.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The published record identifies ztf2r.zip and MD5 daa7bc45c67579253eebe6b1c09dfbd9.
The g-band archive integrity checks passed. Seq 615170 has zero g rows; Seq 615172 has 132 rows with median separation 0.5202627 arcsec and mean g magnitude delta +0.00004545 mag.
Table 2 reports Nr=113 and coordinates RA 307.36563 deg, Dec -13.42128 deg.

expected_improvement: Acquire r-band evidence independent of the g-band archive.
Report row counts for Seq 615170 and Seq 615172 and all source IDs with rows within two arcseconds of the Table 2 target.
Record the r archive checksum, extracted-member SHA-256, byte count, row count, field distribution, and malformed-row count.

correctness.before: The identity lead is supported by g-band data only; the r-band archive has not been independently scanned.
correctness.after: The r-band scan will compare the target and orphan Seq counts, coordinate separations, HJD, r magnitude, error and flags, while preserving all nearby SourceIDs as candidates.

reproducibility.before: The Zenodo r archive MD5 is published, but no extracted-member hash, size or row count is pinned in the project evidence.
reproducibility.after: The first run records independent extracted-member SHA-256, size and row count. These values remain discovery evidence until reviewed and pinned in a second reproducibility run.

failure_analysis.hypothesis: The 113 r-band rows associated with Table 2 Seq 615170 may be stored under a nearby orphan SourceID, potentially Seq 615172. This must be tested against the raw archive.

open_blockers: Run the synthetic tests and the source-backed r archive scan.
Review the archive MD5, extracted-member SHA-256, size, row count, ZIP CRC and malformed-row count.
If the first scan is complete, pin the observed extracted-member SHA-256, size and row count and rerun independently.
Reconcile all r-band SourceID counts against Table 2 Nr; the targeted scan is not a full reconciliation.
Do not change the CPVS selector or infer a source-ID remapping from spatial proximity alone.

knowledge_carried_forward: The r-band scan is a discovery step; its first observed member hash/size/row count are not independently pinned.
The 2-arcsecond radius only retrieves candidate rows. It is not an identity rule.
Do not map SourceIDs automatically and do not claim that this scan resolves the 11,602 membership discrepancy.
Do not modify thresholds, selector, published reference, or frozen v0.2.0 artifacts.
